label: Manual mapping (explicit select / mapper functions)
description: No mapping library. Reads select the response shape directly; anything computed goes through a small pure mapper function. Most explicit, zero magic, more typing.
$comment: The crud_* vars are consumed by orm/efcore's CrudService.cs template. All three mapping fragments must define the SAME keys — erb throws on a missing path, and "" is falsy, which is how the template skips a block. This fragment is also the auto-selected mapping for NestJS, where the crud_* vars simply go unread.

vars.name: manual mapping
quality_checks: Reads select the response shape directly — never load a full row and discard most of it
vars.crud_details_read: QueryById(id).Select(e => new EntityNameDetails(e.Id, e.Name, e.RelatedEntityId, e.RelatedEntity!.Name, e.CreatedAt)).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct)
